HOME.SUMMARY: I'm a fullstack software engineer based in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. I build scalable applications, and I care a lot about how fast they run and how they feel to use. Working across the front-end and back-end, I can take a feature all the way from the database to the interface.

ABOUT.TITLE: About
ABOUT.SUMMARY_1: Hey, I'm Matheus, a fullstack developer based in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. I got into this through graphic design, messing around in Photoshop, and that curiosity slowly pulled me toward web development. I've been hooked ever since.
ABOUT.SUMMARY_2: I've got almost 6 years of experience now, and I still like picking up new things. I'm especially into design patterns and principles, and I try to actually use them instead of just reading about them.
ABOUT.SUMMARY_3: I started out as a trainee writing Ruby on Rails, and since then I've picked up Vue, NestJS, React, Go and a handful of others. What I like most is building user-centric applications that solve real problems, and shipping something that works well and looks good too.
ABOUT.SUMMARY_4: When I'm not coding, I'm usually watching something about what's new in tech or trying out some tool or framework I just came across. Thanks for stopping by and getting to know me a bit!

CIMOL.RESUME_1: CIMOL is a technical school with courses in areas like IT, design, and electronics.
CIMOL.RESUME_2: I took the technical track alongside regular high school, which covered programming, web development, graphic design, and hardware. It gave me a solid base in IT pretty early on.
CIMOL.RESUME_3: By the time I finished, I felt ready to start working. The hands-on projects made the jump into my first job a lot smoother than I expected.

UNISINOS.RESUME_1: The Internet Systems degree digs into how internet technologies and systems actually work, not just the code but how the whole ecosystem fits together. It's a solid grounding for web development.
UNISINOS.RESUME_2: It leaned heavily on practical work, and I graduated in 2025 knowing how to build things that actually ship.

SCOPI.RESUME_1: Scopi makes software for strategic planning, project management, and performance tracking. As a trainee, I built new features and maintained existing ones on their main product.
SCOPI.RESUME_2: This is where I first worked with Angular, Ruby, and SQL on real projects. It's also where I learned how a team actually runs day to day, working in SCRUM and figuring out how to collaborate with people.
SCOPI.RESUME_3: Scopi was a good place to start, and a lot of how I work today comes from that time.

MINHA_VISITA.RESUME_1: Minha Visita is a startup that helps teams manage commercial visits to customers. As a fullstack developer, I work on new features and keep the existing product running.
MINHA_VISITA.RESUME_2: Right now we're rebuilding the product from the ground up with Vue and NestJS. I dig into problems in our services and the app, then propose and build fixes that scale.
MINHA_VISITA.RESUME_3: I work closely with the team to keep the experience consistent across the web app and the mobile apps.

FULLSTACK_LABS.RESUME_1: At Fullstack Labs I was placed with a US-based client, working on their main product. I worked alongside a senior team to keep the experience consistent across web and mobile.
FULLSTACK_LABS.RESUME_2: Developing new features and improving existing ones with Vue, Nuxt, Vuetify, Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, and Docker, working in an Agile setup with active participation in SCRUM ceremonies.
FULLSTACK_LABS.RESUME_3: Built a fully containerized CI testing pipeline with Docker, running automated end-to-end tests with Jest, Cypress, and RSpec so the code stayed reliable across environments.

HIPEOPLE.RESUME_1: Collaborating with an international team to build AI-driven Hiring Intelligence solutions including Voice/Resume Screening, Assessments, and Reference Check using OpenAI APIs, NLP, and LLM-based pipelines.
HIPEOPLE.RESUME_2: Architected scalable systems with React, Next.js, and Go (Echo). Implemented CI/CD, Vitest automation, and Dockerized environments for efficient development and deployment processes.
HIPEOPLE.RESUME_3: Built realtime AI integrations with OpenAI Realtime Conversations, working in an Agile/Linear workflow and using Claude daily to ship faster.
HIPEOPLE.RESUME_4: Led a front-end performance overhaul that cut the initial JS payload by 65% (over 1 MB), lifted Lighthouse scores from 18 to 60+, and reduced weekly production errors by 85%.

PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.JSON_SEARCHER: JSON Searcher is a simple VSCode extension for searching within JSON files, particularly useful for locating data in i18n (internationalization) files.
PROJECTS.WW_HIDE_CHATS_TOOLS: My newest project, currently a work in progress (WIP), is a Chrome extension designed to hide, blur, and provide many more features for chats on WhatsApp Web.
PROJECTS.SUPRA_CRM: A CRM for small Brazilian retail stores, bringing products, orders, customers and finances into one system. It runs in the browser, works offline and syncs to the cloud when the connection comes back.
PROJECTS.HIPEOPLE: AI hiring platform covering voice and resume screening, assessments and reference checks. I work across the React and Go stack and led a performance overhaul that cut the initial JS payload by 65%.
PROJECTS.BENCHPREP: Learning platform for certification training, exam prep and continuing education. Through Fullstack Labs, I built features on the main product and a containerized CI pipeline for end-to-end tests.
PROJECTS.MINHA_VISITA: Platform for managing field teams and commercial visits, with offline checklists, real-time reports and geolocation. I helped rebuild it from the ground up with Vue and NestJS.
PROJECTS.THIS_SITE: Yep, you're looking at it. This site was engineered to feel instant. A lean Vue 3 SPA bundled with Vite and Rolldown, with native animations, code-split sections, and modern media formats. Every byte was measured.
PROJECTS.GB_EMU: A work in progress Game Boy emulator written from scratch in Go, built as a low level study of CPU and hardware emulation. It already parses the cartridge header and decodes a handful of CPU instructions.
